item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Modular Gear Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco's Modular Gear Bag is big enough to take all of your equipment with you while supporting the men and women in blue.
description: Rothco's Modular Gear Bag is big enough to take all of your equipment with you while supporting the men and women in blue. With dimension's of 33" x 16" x 15", this bag can fit everything. The gear bag features 1.5" blue webbing on both the front and back sides, supporting the Thin Blue Line. A large main compartment with a U-shaped design makes putting gear away simple, and the wrap around handles make it easy to carry. It even has an adjustable shoulder strap with a reversible shoulder pad for added comfort.
